task.objective: Publish and verify the approved release candidate across configured release targets.

result.summary: GitHub Release, CDN, Stripe links, and controlled entitlement probes are verified. Chrome Web Store publication is blocked before listing upload because there is no approved 4.5.7 Market Package and its required fresh media remains incomplete.
result.implementedReleaseSolution: Published immutable release artifact v4.5.7 from the managed release commit, uploaded the public site to Qiniu, refreshed the remaining stale cache entry, verified the configured production bundle and both live Payment Links, and probed entitlement activation without submitting a payment.
result.deviations: No Chrome Web Store draft upload, listing update, or review submission was made because the required approved 4.5.7 listing inputs were absent.

tests.scope: 35 focused helper checks plus configuration, feedback, Premium-state, and meeting-file checks

releaseWorkflow.configuredProductionBundleCheck: passed for one-time and weekly Payment Links with no Stripe secret material

verification.method: Downloaded every www/ object and compared SHA-256 with the release checkout; privacy.html was additionally verified through its exact Content-MD5 header because Cloudflare email-protection rewrites its rendered HTML body.

objects.renderedBodyNote: Cloudflare email-protection changes the rendered body and injected script, so SHA-256 is not stable across requests.

targets.requested: verify configured public payment surfaces without purchase

links.visualEvidence: Rendered Stripe Checkout page showed $1.99 USD and CA$2.95 currency options; no Pay button was used.
Rendered Stripe Checkout page showed Subscribe to MeetMate Premium Weekly, CA$2.95 per week, billed weekly, and the USD authorization at $1.99; no Subscribe button was used.

verification.successPageValidation: Invalid or missing session IDs render the explicit missing-or-invalid state and remove the activation link.
